verdict.rationale: Missive ships an official MCP server. The changelog says external AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can connect via MCP and act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with user-chosen permissions. Later changelog entries reference drafts created "through the API and MCP server", the pricing page lists "API & MCP access", and a probe found dedicated server docs at /docs/ai/mcp/server. The Custom MCP client feature for Missive's own Copilot was not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence of the server's tool list, auth/setup flow, and plan limits.
